newsitem.title: USA: Newcor completes machine tool unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Newcor completes machine tool unit sale.

text.p: Newcor Inc said Friday it completed the previously announced sale of its machine tool division to A. Machine Tool Co.
The sale was part of the company's strategy to focus on internal growth.

"We intend to redeploy the proceeds from the sale of Machine Tool to help fund internal growth and the continued acquisition of companies that complement the remaining businesses in our components and assemblies segment," said W. John Weinhardt, president and chief executive.
Machine Tool, based in Fraser, Michigan, manufactures multi-station metal cutting machines.
Newcor provides precision-machined and molded rubber and plastic products.
